sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 232380, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Standard $31, electric $40, full hookup $46, group site $50 (FS page, updated January 2026; rec.gov 2026 peak season Mar 20 - Nov 15, standard nonelectric $31). Winter (Nov 16 - Mar 20): sites 1-13 walk-up only at $15/night, paid by cash or check in the fee tube. $5 per extra vehicle.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/north-mills-river-campground ('Standard: $31 Electric: $40 Full Hook Up (FHU): $46 Group site: $50') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-20 to 2026-11-15: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 31) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380 (Winter Operations: 'Sites 1-13 are available on a first-come, first-served basis for $15 per night'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Catalog: 20 standard non-electric, 1 RV electric (014, 28 ft) and 3 tent-only family sites plus a group tent area and 4 management sites. All back-ins; most RV sites take only 18-20 ft, seven take 30-35 ft. Sites 14-26 close in winter.

sites.source: recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232380 (site types, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380 ('Sites 14-26 are closed during winter'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Bathhouse with hot showers and flush toilets March 20 - November 15; in winter no running water or electricity, pit toilets only. Firewood sold on site ($10).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380 ('restrooms with hot showers and flush toilets'; winter 'No running water No electricity Pit toilets only') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/north-mills-river-campground ('Potable water is available at this site', 'Flush toilets and showers in bath house'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Full services March 20 - November 15; November 16 - March 20 sites 1-13 only, walk-up, limited services.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380 ('Open year-round with full services March 20 - November 15. Winter operations (November 16 - March 20) feature walk-up sites only with limited services') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/north-mills-river-campground ('Site Open'; 'Year-round, Limited services, November-March'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov up to 6 months ahead, March 20 - November 15; winter sites are walk-up only and cannot be reserved. 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. Check in with the campground host before setting up. Concession-run by Naventure.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232380 (rules reservationWindow 6 Months, maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; 'Winter sites cannot be reserved online'; 'This campground is managed by Naventure'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Pisgah NF (Pisgah RD), concession-run by Naventure; two loops on opposite sides of the North Mills River, mostly shaded. Bear-country food storage rules enforced. --Claude
summary: Open (FS page 'Site Open'; no Helene closure in the NC forests' alerts for this campground). Confirmed $31-46 (standard / full hookup), year-round with limited winter service, reservable on rec.gov. Changed site count 26 -> 24 family sites (catalog) and added max 35 ft, all back-in; added flush toilets, showers, water, 6-month window, 14-night limit. Hookups left unset: one RV ELECTRIC site with water but no amperage in the catalog. Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Hookups: the FS page prices Electric ($40) and Full Hook Up ($46) sites, but the rec.gov catalog has only one RV ELECTRIC site (014, 28 ft, water yes, no amperage) and no sewer attribute; electric/sewer left unknown.
Fit: 10 of the RV-capable sites are rated 18 ft and 4 at 20 ft; only sites 3, 4, 6, 10, 12, 13, 20 (30-35 ft) and 14 (28 ft) take a 23-ft rig.
Phone: entry 828-577-4167 is Naventure's campground line (both pages); rec.gov's facility phone is (828) 552-8040; Pisgah RD office (828) 866-3437.
